function m32ValidKey(x){return typeof x==='string'&&(/^(Shift\+)?[A-Z0-9]$/.test(x)||x==='Enter'||x==='Shift+Enter');}
function m32Overlap(a,b){return a==='confirm'||b==='confirm';} // Confirmation exclusively owns its interrupted context.
function m32Bindings(){
 const raw=Rt.getState().mod32Hotkeys,src=raw&&typeof raw==='object'&&!Array.isArray(raw)?raw:{};
 const out={};for(const row of M32_KEYS)out[row.id]=Object.hasOwn(src,row.id)&&(src[row.id]===''||m32ValidKey(src[row.id]))?src[row.id]:row.key;
 // Foreign/malformed settings never dispatch two actions. Preserve the first registered binding.
 const used=[];for(const row of M32_KEYS){const key=out[row.id];if(key&&used.some(x=>x.key===key&&!m32Overlap(x.id,row.id)))out[row.id]='';else if(key)used.push({id:row.id,key});}
 return out;
}
function m32Assign(id,key){
 if(!M32_KEYS.some(x=>x.id===id))return '알 수 없는 항목입니다.';
 if(key!==''&&!m32ValidKey(key))return '영문자·숫자·Enter 또는 Shift 조합을 사용하세요. Esc는 닫기로 고정됩니다.';
 const next=m32Bindings(),conflict=M32_KEYS.find(x=>x.id!==id&&key&&next[x.id]===key&&!m32Overlap(id,x.id));
 if(conflict)return '이미 “'+conflict.label+'”에 지정된 키입니다. 먼저 해당 지정을 해제하세요.';
 next[id]=key;Rt.getState().set({mod32Hotkeys:next});return '';
}
function m32Hint(old){return m32Bindings()[old==='↵'?'enter':String(old??'').toLowerCase()]??'';}

function m32EventKey(e){
 if(e.ctrlKey||e.altKey||e.metaKey||e.isComposing||e.keyCode===229)return '';
 let key='';if(e.key==='Enter')key='Enter';else if(/^Key[A-Z]$/.test(e.code??''))key=e.code.slice(3);else if(/^(Digit|Numpad)[0-9]$/.test(e.code??''))key=e.code.slice(-1);else if(/^[a-z0-9]$/i.test(e.key??''))key=e.key.toUpperCase();
 return key?(e.shiftKey?'Shift+':'')+key:'';
}

function m31Daily(s){const m=m31Copy(s);if(!m.seed)m.seed=m31Hash((s.primaryCharacterId??'')+':'+g(s).name+':'+(s.rngState??s.slot)+':guild')||1;if(m.daily?.day===s.day)return m313UpgradeDaily(s,m);const cat=m31Catalog(s),seed=m.seed+':'+s.day,rank=ids=>ids.sort((a,b)=>m31Rand(seed+':rank:'+a)-m31Rand(seed+':rank:'+b)),items={};const pick=(kind,count,min,max,filter=()=>true)=>{for(const x of rank(Object.keys(cat).filter(id=>cat[id].kind===kind&&filter(cat[id]))).slice(0,count))items[x]={price:m313Price(cat[x].price*(.9+.2*m31Rand(seed+':price:'+x))),stock:min+Math.floor(m31Rand(seed+':stock:'+x)*(max-min+1))};};
 pick('material',16,3,8,x=>!x.rare);pick('material',1+Math.floor(m31Rand(seed+':rare')*3),1,2,x=>x.rare);pick('knowledge',2+Math.floor(m31Rand(seed+':books')*3),1,1);pick('attribute',6,1,1);pick('trait',6,1,1);pick('cup',6,2,4);for(const id of ['energy','fatigue'])items[id]={price:m313Price(cat[id].price*(.9+.2*m31Rand(seed+':price:'+id))),stock:10};

function m31Block(s){return s.gameOver?'게임이 끝났습니다.':s.pendingEvent?'진행 중인 선택지를 먼저 해결하세요.':s.errandSession?'외출을 마친 뒤 이용하세요.':Ye(s)||Y(s)?.playerEngaged||uo(s)?'진행 중인 장면을 먼저 마무리하세요.':!Lo(s)?'주점으로 돌아온 뒤 이용하세요.':'';}
function m31Quote(s,cart,delivery){const m=m31Daily(s),cat=m31Catalog(s),rows=[],seen=new Set;let cost=0,space=0,traits=0;const error=m31Block(s);if(error)return{error};if(!Array.isArray(cart)||!cart.length)return{error:'품목과 수량을 선택하세요.'};for(const x of cart){const p=cat[x.id],q=x.qty;if(!p||seen.has(x.id)||!Number.isInteger(q)||q<1||q>999)return{error:'수량 또는 품목이 올바르지 않습니다.'};seen.add(x.id);const row=m316Offer(s,p,m);if(!row||row.stock<q)return{error:p.name+' 재고가 부족합니다.'};if(p.kind==='knowledge'&&(yo(s).known[p.key]?.length??0)>=Jo[p.key].properties.length)return{error:p.name+'은 이미 알고 있습니다.'};if(['attribute','trait','energy','fatigue'].includes(p.kind)&&(m.inventory[x.id]??0)+q>p.limit)return{error:p.name+' 보관 한도: '+p.limit};if(p.kind==='trait')traits+=q;if(p.kind==='material'||p.kind==='cup')space+=q;cost+=row.price*q;rows.push({id:x.id,qty:q});}if(traits+Object.entries(m.inventory).filter(([id])=>cat[id]?.kind==='trait').reduce((n,[,v])=>n+v,0)>10)return{error:'성향 상품은 합계 10개까지 보관합니다.'};if(space>Math.max(0,Jf(s)-Kf(s)))return{error:'재료·물약 보관함 공간이 부족합니다.'};const total=Math.round(cost*(delivery?1.25:1));return{cost:total,subtotal:cost,fee:total-cost,rows,m,space};}
function m31Deliver(s,cart){const m=m31Copy(s),cat=m31Catalog(s);for(const x of cart){const p=cat[x.id];if(p.kind==='supply')s={...s,supplies:{...s.supplies,[p.key]:(s.supplies[p.key]??0)+x.qty}};else if(p.kind==='material')s=VS(s,{[p.key]:x.qty}).state;else if(p.kind==='knowledge')s=tbe(s,p.key);else if(p.kind==='cup')for(let i=0;i<x.qty;i++){m.serial++;s=Zye(s,{id:'guild-'+m.seed+'-'+m.serial,effects:p.effects,from:p.recipe,day:s.day});}else m.inventory[x.id]=(m.inventory[x.id]??0)+x.qty;}return m31Put(s,m);}
function m31Buy(s,a){const original=s;const q=m31Quote(s,a.cart,!!a.delivery);if(q.error)return j(s,q.error);if(q.cost>s.economy.gold)return j(s,'골드가 부족합니다.');let m=q.m;for(const x of q.rows)if(!m316Unlimited(m)&&m.daily.items[x.id])m.daily.items[x.id].stock-=x.qty;s=m31Put({...s,economy:{...s.economy,gold:s.economy.gold-q.cost}},m);if(a.delivery)return j(m31Deliver(s,q.rows),'길드 배달이 도착했습니다. '+q.cost+'골드를 지불했습니다.');
 const started=Zr(s,'market',{purchase:{cart:{},cost:0},header:'상인 연합 길드로 장보러 갑니다. 왕복 60분 후 구매품을 정리합니다.'});if(!started.errandSession)return j(original,'길드 장보기를 시작하지 못해 결제를 취소했습니다.');m=m31Copy(started);m.trip={...(m316Unlimited(q.m)?{stockBypassed:true}:{}),cart:q.rows,cost:q.cost,start:s.slot,day:s.day};return m31Put({...started,errandSession:{...started.errandSession,returnAtSlot:s.slot+60}},m);}

// Exact, reviewed generated-name aliases. Never rewrite stored or displayed names.
function koGeneratedNameSource020(name) {
  if (typeof name !== 'string') return name;
  const first = koIdentityLogData020.first;
  if (Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(first, name)) return first[name];
  const space = name.indexOf(' ');
  if (space < 0) return name;
  const head = name.slice(0, space), tail = name.slice(space + 1);
  if (!Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(first, head) ||
      !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(koIdentityLogData020.last, tail)) return name;
  return first[head] + ' ' + koIdentityLogData020.last[tail];
}
function koGeneratedNameExcluded020(excluded, name) {
  return excluded.has(name) || excluded.has(koGeneratedNameSource020(name));
}
function koGeneratedNameLength020(name) {
  // The five canonical named patrons already have reviewed EN/KO aliases.
  // Exact matching only; no substring replacement or change to the visible name.
  const named = Object.values(koNamedAliases29).find(aliases => aliases.includes(name));
  return (named ? named[0] : koGeneratedNameSource020(name)).length;
}

// Only the complete authored hunt-return grammar is accepted. Unknown nouns,
// malformed quantities, unrelated suffixes and incorrect resolved particles fall back.
function koHuntParticle020(word, particle) {
  if (particle === '을(를)') return true;
  const code = word.charCodeAt(word.length - 1);
  return code >= 44032 && code <= 55203 && particle === ((code - 44032) % 28 ? '을' : '를');
}
function koHuntGoods020(text, particle) {
  const output = []; let last = '';
  for (const item of text.split(', ')) {
    const match = /^([1-9][0-9]*) (.+)$/.exec(item);
    if (!match || match[0] !== item || !Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(koIdentityLogData020.parts, match[2])) return undefined;
    output.push(match[1] + ' ' + koIdentityLogData020.parts[match[2]]); last = match[2];
  }
  if (particle !== undefined && !koHuntParticle020(last, particle)) return undefined;
  return output.join(', ');
}
